email.subject: Action required: we couldn't finish creating your ThisIsTea account

body.v: Something went wrong while we were finalising your account.
To finish, please re-enter your email address and password.
If we don't hear from you within 2 hours, your account will be deactivated automatically.

hotspots.explain: Two letters swapped and a word added: thisistae-app.example is not thisistea.example.
An ordinary greeting. Real companies say hello too.
Anyone could write this sentence, and it asks nothing of you. Look for the part that wants something from you.
ThisIsTea will never ask for your password by email.
"within 2 hours": a short deadline, so that you act before you've checked.
The button points to the same lookalike domain.

who.prompt: Who is really writing to you? Read the address, not just the name.
who.answer: Someone posing as ThisIsTea. The address is thisistae-app.example: two letters swapped and a word added.
choices: An impostor with a near-identical address

emotion.prompt: Which feeling is this email pressing on?
emotion.answer: Fear and haste: your account will be deactivated unless you act within two hours.
choices: Curiosity: something new to try out
Fear and haste: two hours to act

ask.prompt: What does it actually want you to do?
ask.answer: Re-enter your email address and password, which would hand your login details to the sender.

verify.prompt: How can you check through a channel you control?
verify.answer: Never type a password after clicking an email link. Open ThisIsTea yourself, from a bookmark or by typing the address.
choices: Click the link to see the page
Reply to the email asking for help
Open ThisIsTea yourself, via a bookmark

actions.label: Open ThisIsTea yourself by typing the address
actions.consequence: Your account is working normally. The email was fake.

actions.label: Click the link and re-enter your password
actions.consequence: Your login details go straight to the scammer.

actions.label: Report it to the IT team, then delete it
actions.consequence: The IT team can now warn the other recipients.

attacker_reveal: A near-identical address, a two-hour deadline, a login form. Three ingredients, and most people notice none of them.
